# Petrichor

> Petrichor is a small research laboratory founded in Austin, Texas. This research involves cloud seeding for rain enhancement across Texas. Petrichor develops open source software, neural networks, and quadcopter drones.

The full text of every page is in one file: [llms-full.txt](https://meteorology.sh/llms-full.txt).

## Pages

- [Home](https://meteorology.sh/): Rain enhancement research for Texas storms, with current weather conditions over Austin.
- [About](https://meteorology.sh/about): Who we are, what cloud seeding is about, and how it serves the natural resource interests of Texas.
- [Research](https://meteorology.sh/research): An overview of Weatherman, a decision science platform; Automata, a reinforcement learning harness; and Hyades, the quadcopter drone platform.
- [Contact](https://meteorology.sh/contact): Where the lab publishes its source code, how to reach it by email, and where it posts its research.

## Full text

- [llms-full.txt](https://meteorology.sh/llms-full.txt): The text of every page on this site, in Markdown.
